server.name: comply
server.instructions: Comply guides a compliance assessment. Speak to the user in their language. Publish all scope, evidence, conclusions, and exports in English. Call get_assessment_state after each answer and follow next_actions.

tools.name: get_agent_guide
tools.title: Get the guided assessment workflow
tools.description: Return the step-by-step journey and the language policy. Call this once when the user asks how the audit works. The agent speaks the user's language and publishes in English.

tools.name: start_assessment
tools.title: Start a guided assessment
tools.description: Create an assessment for one framework. If scope is omitted, the journey starts at the scope step. Returns progress, blockers, and next actions.

scope.description: Systems, locations, and boundaries in English.

limit.description: How many requirements to include. Defaults to every requirement in the framework.

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.title: List assessments
tools.description: List the assessments of the current tenant, newest first, with pagination metadata.

tools.name: get_assessment_state
tools.title: Get assessment state
tools.description: Read the phase, progress, blockers, and next actions. Call it after every user answer so the guidance stays current.

tools.name: set_scope
tools.title: Confirm scope
tools.description: Store the English scope, systems, locations, and assessment period.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.title: Get the prioritized brief
tools.description: Return up to five requirements to work on, each with an English question to ask the user.

tools.name: list_requirements
tools.title: List requirements
tools.description: Paginate the assessment checklist. Filter by status or search reference, title, description, and conclusion. Returns page_info with total_pages, next_page, and previous_page.

tools.name: search_requirements
tools.title: Search requirements by similarity
tools.description: Rank the assessment checklist by lexical similarity to an English query or to another requirement. Use it to find related controls, duplicates, or requirements that one artifact may cover. Translate the user's terms into English first.

query.description: English terms to search for, for example incident response.

similarTo.description: Requirement id to use as the reference text instead of a query.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.title: Track assessment progress
tools.description: Return completion counts by status and theme, the next open requirements, recent events, and the next action. Use it to report progress without fetching the full checklist.

tools.name: get_requirement
tools.title: Get one requirement
tools.description: Return the requirement text, evidence already collected, and the question to ask the user.

tools.name: submit_evidence
tools.title: Submit evidence
tools.description: Attach an artifact to a requirement. The summary must be in English and must state what the artifact shows. Never send credentials or raw secrets.

source.description: System, team, or document the evidence comes from.

summary.description: English summary of the result shown by the evidence.

citation.description: URL, ticket, document id, or location the auditor can verify.

tools.name: complete_requirement
tools.title: Complete a requirement
tools.description: Record the English conclusion and close the requirement. At least one evidence artifact is required.

conclusion.description: One or two English sentences grounded in the evidence.

tools.name: mark_not_applicable
tools.title: Mark a requirement not applicable
tools.description: Close a requirement that does not apply, with an English reason the auditor can review.

tools.name: review_assessment
tools.title: Review the assessment
tools.description: Check that every requirement is complete and move the assessment to export.

tools.name: export_assessment
tools.title: Export the audit package
tools.description: Return the English audit package with manifest, citations, hashes, and conclusions. The assessment must be reviewed first.
